changes.purpose: Retain inherited CityOS documentation, examples, recipes, plugins and CI consumers from the recorded fork baseline.
changes.invariant: Public source boundaries, docs examples, core build ordering and single-runtime AI integration remain maintained.

changes.purpose: Retain catalog-derived runtimes, native package manager and exact third-party compatibility overlays.
changes.invariant: No ambient runtime fallback, stale generated pins or incompatible peer graph.

changes.purpose: Preserve public registration and independently bundled custom fields.
changes.invariant: Versioned registration, current permissions, renderer identity, structured values and creation defaults remain compatible.

changes.purpose: Assemble public bundles and type exports with stable dependency APIs. Declare the host React DOM runtime as a catalog-derived peer.
changes.invariant: Data transforms, public exports and prepared consumers stay executable.

changes.purpose: Retain stable rich-text browser/server renderer compatibility.
changes.invariant: Authored rich text renders without browser-only server dependencies.

changes.purpose: Preserve reserved root indexes and configured slot constraints.
changes.invariant: Root order/indexes survive traversal and illegal root drops are rejected.

changes.purpose: Execute source/evidence fixtures through the installed Git Bash rather than an ambient WSL launcher.
changes.invariant: Recorded command exit codes, stdout/stderr and exact-source identities remain testable on Windows and POSIX.

changes.purpose: Publish the tested tarball from a SHA-bound qualification bundle without rebuilding an unverified replacement.
changes.invariant: Clean source, exact lock/artifact/log digests, executed required checks and owned package/version are verified before npm publication.

changes.purpose: Use the selected Node runtime for workspace package output cleanup on Windows and POSIX.
changes.invariant: Only the verified package dist child can be removed; linked output and foreign directories are refused.

nonClaims: Inventory is not qualification, publication, runtime activation or approval.
